ai_report_text: Possible pulmonary nodule identified in the right upper lobe. Recommend follow-up CT for further evaluation.
Small left-sided pleural effusion detected. Clinical correlation recommended.
Small left pneumothorax identified. Urgent clinical correlation recommended.
Pulmonary nodule measuring approximately 8mm in the left lower lobe. Follow-up imaging recommended per Fleischner criteria.
Hypodense lesion in hepatic segment VI measuring 2.3 cm. Differential includes hemangioma and metastasis. MRI with contrast recommended.
Dilated appendix with periappendiceal fat stranding. Findings consistent with acute appendicitis.
Hyperdense focus in the right basal ganglia consistent with acute hemorrhage. Urgent neurosurgical consultation recommended.
Large acute intraparenchymal hemorrhage in the left temporal lobe with surrounding edema and mild midline shift.
Complex tear of the medial meniscus posterior horn extending to the articular surface. Associated joint effusion.
Enhancing mass in the right frontal lobe measuring 3.1 x 2.8 cm with surrounding vasogenic edema. Recommend neurosurgical consultation.
Irregular hypoechoic mass at 2 o'clock position, 4 cm from the nipple. BI-RADS 4. Tissue sampling recommended.
Solid hypoechoic thyroid nodule in the right lobe measuring 1.4 cm with irregular margins and microcalcifications. ACR TI-RADS 4. FNA recommended.
Multiple echogenic foci within the gallbladder with posterior acoustic shadowing, consistent with cholelithiasis.
Cardiothoracic ratio exceeds 0.5, consistent with cardiomegaly. Bilateral interstitial markings may indicate early pulmonary congestion.
Thin lucent line along the right lung apex with absent lung markings laterally, consistent with pneumothorax.
